svg.title: Online tuition across Scotland
svg.desc: An illustrated map of mainland Scotland, the Hebrides, Orkney and Shetland. Inverness, Aberdeen, Glasgow and Edinburgh are labelled as geographic references. EFL support is online, available throughout Scotland.
svg.metadata: Contains Ordnance Survey, Office of National Statistics, National Records Scotland and LPS Intellectual Property data © Crown copyright and database right [2016]. Data from martinjc/UK-GeoJSON, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3; OS data under OS OpenData Licence. Simplified for illustration. Full attribution in scotland-map-attribution.txt.
svg.text: All of Scotland. One online classroom.
